description: Find Federal Statistical Office (BFS) tables on STAT-TAB by keywords: population, births, deaths, migration, tourism overnight stays, crime, students, vehicles, buildings, enterprises and hundreds more. Returns table ids (e.g. 'px-x-0102010000_101') with titles, to pass to get_bfs_table_metadata then query_bfs_table. Titles are in the chosen language, so use matching search terms (e.g. lang='de', query 'Logiernächte Kanton'). Examples: {query:'population commune age'}, {query:'hotel overnight stays', lang:'en'}.

lang.description: Language of titles/labels: de, fr, it or en (default en)

name: search_bfs_tables
title: Search BFS STAT-TAB statistical tables
